def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    benches = image_patch.find("bench")
    occupied_benches = image_patch.find("person on bench")
    
    free_benches = [b for b in benches if b not in occupied_benches]
    
    return free_benches
